```artifact
Feature: System Backup and Authentication
  Background: This feature tests the backup and authentication functionalities of the system.

  # For requirement U32_13
  Scenario: Nightly full backup and rotation
    Given the system is operational at the end of the day
    When the nightly backup process is initiated
    Then the system should successfully back up both the database and code
    And the backup should be stored at the remote site
    And the backup rotation should occur every 30 days

  # For requirement VIRTUA-13-1
  Scenario: Doctors/Chemists password change
    Given a user with credentials to access the system
    When they attempt to change their password
    Then the system should allow the password change
    And confirm the new password

  # For requirement VIRTUA-13-2
  Scenario: Patient registration with User-id/Password creation
    Given a patient is attempting to register
    When they provide their details
    Then the system should create a unique User-id and Password
    And confirm the creation of User-id and Password

  # For requirement VIRTUA-13-3
  Scenario: Doctor wise Appointment file generation
    Given a doctor is active on the system
    When the end of the day is reached
    And it is the last day of the month
    Then the system should generate an appointment file for the next 5 days

  # For requirement VIRTUA-13-3
  Scenario: Speciality wise Consultations count
    Given a doctor with a speciality is active on the system
    When the end of the day is reached
    And it is the last day of the month
    Then the system should report the number of consultations by the doctor for the month/quarter/year

  # For requirement VIRTUA-13-3
  Scenario: Speciality wise Revenue Earned report
    Given a doctor with a speciality is active on the system
    When the end of the day is reached
    And it is the last day of the month
    Then the system should report the revenue earned by the doctor for the month/quarter/year

```
